articles.title: Race Cars Zoom Past Museums: Will the Art Be Okay?
articles.summary: IndyCar racers will speed up to 180 mph around Washington D.C.'s National Mall this weekend. Some people worry the vibrations could hurt the art inside museums. A giant blue rooster sculpture sits right by the track!

articles.title: GCSE Results Are In: What's Really Going On?
articles.summary: This year's GCSE results look a lot like 2019's, but there are some big surprises. Nearly a quarter of maths and English exams were taken by students 17 or older who were resitting. The government calls the system "demoralising."

articles.title: Democrats Pick Three Cities for Their Big 2028 Party
articles.summary: The Democratic Party is choosing where to hold its huge 2028 presidential convention. They've narrowed it down to Boston, Denver, or Philadelphia. The winner will host thousands of people in August 2028.
